offering_description.value: The company designs and manufactures wellheads and other pressure control equipment for onshore and offshore oil and gas operations. It makes equipment in its own facilities and provides field installation, servicing and rentals.

quotes.quote: Cactus Wellhead™ manufactures and services pressure control equipment for onshore and offshore oil and gas drilling, completion and production. Our experience is unparalleled. Key managers have not only accumulated decades of knowledge in the industry but have also worked together as a team for an average of 25 years. As a company, our roots go back 50 years and three generations.

In order to provide the best and most reliable results for our customers, we engage the industry’s most experienced engineers, manufacture in Cactus™ owned facilities and incorporate stringent quality and safety standards. Our strategically located branch operation centers are manned by associates who focus on partnering with our customers.

primary_products.value: Wellhead systems; other pressure control equipment

quotes.quote: Cactus Wellhead™ designs and manufactures highly-engineered wellheads and pressure control equipment.

Cactus™ SafeDrill ® Wellhead Systems include a complete line of drill-through single piece multi-bowl wellhead systems that enhance field personnel safety and save valuable rig time. These efficient and innovative systems, with a straight bore design and lock ring technology, are safer, easier and faster to install than conventional wellhead systems and maximize the benefits of pad drilling.

primary_services.value: Equipment installation; equipment servicing; equipment rental

quotes.quote: Cactus Wellhead™ products and systems are designed and manufactured to the highest industry standards. We have implemented a fully documented API Spec 6A and Q1/ISO 9001:2015 quality management system that supports our state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities. Hands-on involvement and communication by branch operations, installation crews and manufacturing facilities ensure that Cactus Wellhead™ is fully committed to quality excellence and reduction of risk.
